newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jardine in lighting JV with TLG.
newsitem.headline: Jardine in lighting JV with TLG.

text.p: Jardine Pacific on Monday said it has agreed to form a lighting joint venture business with TLG Plc, holding company of the Thorn Lighting Group.
The new company, Thorn Lighting Asian Holdings BV, would be 70 percent owned by TLG and 30 percent owned by Jardine.
Jardine Pacific was formed in 1989 to bring together the diverse Asia-Pacific trading and service activities of the Jardine Matheson Group.

Its business falls in six main areas: trading and distribution, restaurants, engineering and construction, aviation and shipping, security and environment services and financial services and property.
